$comment: Pinned snapshot of each connector's published MCP tool names, checked by scripts/check-connector-tools.mjs. Refresh with node scripts/refresh-connector-tools.mjs (needs node and crane; see CONTRIBUTING.md#connector-mapping). image = the exact image probed. sources: runtime = tools/list from that image; static = name literals in the server repo's src/ (tools gated off by default); conduit-manifest / conduit-staging-baseline = Conduit's own tool inventories; docs = public Conduit docs. tools = null means no list could be captured offline (vendor-hosted servers need a live sign-in); the check skips those and says so.
